headline: Cadence author describes PhotoNet and EEnet models for integrated photonic/electrical/digital verification
fact: Paul Graykowski, identified as a Cadence product-marketing director, describes SystemVerilog real-number modeling of photonic components with PhotoNet and electrical circuits with EEnet in Xcelium. The sponsored technical article targets verification of multi-chip systems containing photonics, analog electronics and digital controllers, and references associated models and adoption examples. March 27 is the article publication date, not a verified initial library release date. It does not identify a customer deployment or establish that the author implemented the libraries.

sources.title: High-Speed High-Capacity Mixed-Signal Simulation of Silicon Photonics
sources.summary: The page is dated March 27, 2025, labels the article Sponsor Blog, identifies Graykowski and Cadence, and describes PhotoNet/EEnet mixed-signal verification.
